points.description: States that storage is a function of inflow and outflow discharge only (storage depends on I and O, found via continuity equation / single-stage assumption).
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely mentions storage relating to flow without naming inflow and outflow.

points.description: States that the parameters K and x (n) are constant for the channel reach (until channel slope/condition changes), and/or K depends on the travel time of the flood wave through the reach.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one vague parameter remark is given.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating the two central ideas in any wording: storage depends on inflow and outflow discharge, and K (and x/n) stay constant for the reach, with K linked to flood wave travel time. Give part marks for a vague or half-stated version of either idea. Give no marks for unrelated assumptions. Spelling and terminology errors, and extra remarks, do not matter.
